items.heading: Grapevine Daily Quote November 24
items.text: Simplicity, devotion, steadfastness, and loyalty; these, we remembered, were the hallmarks of character which Dr. Bob had well implanted in so many of us.
items.attribution: AA Co-Founder, Bill W., September 1950, “We Came of Age”, The Language of the Heart

items.heading: Cita Diaria con La Viña Noviembre 24
items.text: Nos hemos resuelto a no permitir nunca que ni el dinero ni la administración de asuntos necesarios, oscurezcan nuestros objetivos espirituales.
items.attribution: “AA no es un gran negocio”. BILL W., COFUNDADOR DE AA, NOVIEMBRE DE 1950
